news.n_chn_song: They say the guards in Kaifeng have proclaimed their commander Zhao Kuangyin emperor. The new dynasty is called Song.
news.n_chn_cup_of_wine: The story goes that the emperor, over a cup of wine, talked his generals into giving up their armies and retiring to their estates.
news.n_chn_jingnan_hunan: Song troops have taken Jingnan and Hunan almost without a fight.
news.n_chn_shu: News has come: Later Shu in Sichuan has submitted to the Song, and its ruler is being taken to Kaifeng.
news.n_chn_cairo: Arab merchants say that new rulers in Egypt have founded a great city – Cairo.
news.n_chn_southern_han: Song troops have taken Guangzhou; the kingdom of Southern Han has fallen.
news.n_chn_li_yu: Southern Tang has fallen. Its ruler Li Yu, a famous poet, is now a captive in Kaifeng and, they say, writes sorrowful verses.
news.n_chn_taizu_dies: Emperor Taizu has died suddenly in the night; his younger brother has taken the throne. People whisper about a candle and an axe.
news.n_chn_wuyue: Qian Chu, ruler of Wuyue, and the lord of Quanzhou have voluntarily handed their lands to the Song emperor.
news.n_chn_gaoliang: Northern Han is conquered, but near Youzhou the Khitans routed the imperial army at the Gaoliang River. They say the emperor himself fled in a cart, wounded by an arrow.
news.n_chn_taiping_yulan: The court has finished a vast encyclopedia, the Taiping Yulan – a thousand scrolls on everything under heaven.
news.n_chn_yongxi: The new campaign against the Khitans has failed: General Yang Ye was captured and starved himself to death.
news.n_chn_rus: Merchants from the north-west say the ruler of a distant people called the Rus has taken up the faith of the western monks and baptised his people in a river.
news.n_chn_wang_xiaobo: Tea growers in Sichuan have risen. Their leader Wang Xiaobo promises to make rich and poor equal.
news.n_chn_zhenzong: Emperor Taizong has died; his son Zhenzong now reigns.
news.n_chn_mahmud: Merchants from the Southern Seas speak of Sultan Mahmud of Ghazni, who plunders the rich temples of India.
news.n_chn_liao_invades: The Khitans have reached the Yellow River with a huge army. The emperor has gone in person to the troops at Chanyuan.
news.n_chn_chanyuan: Peace has been made with the Khitans: every year the Song will pay in silver and silk.
news.n_chn_heavenly_texts: They say “heavenly letters” have been found in the palace, and the emperor has gone to offer sacrifices on sacred Mount Tai.
news.n_chn_champa_rice: The treasury is handing out Champa rice seed to farmers: it ripens fast and withstands drought.
news.n_chn_empress_liu: Emperor Zhenzong has died. The new sovereign is a child, and the empress dowager Liu rules in his name.
news.n_chn_jiaozi: They say that in Chengdu the treasury itself now prints paper money instead of iron coins.
news.n_chn_xia_emperor: The Tangut chief Li Yuanhao has proclaimed himself emperor of Xia. There will be war in the north-west.
news.n_chn_sanchuankou: News of a defeat: the Tanguts have routed a Song army at Sanchuankou.
news.n_chn_qingli: Minister Fan Zhongyan has proposed ten reforms: fewer idlers in office, more schools.
news.n_chn_wujing: A great military treatise has been compiled, said to include recipes for fire powder. Peace has at last been made with the Tanguts.
news.n_chn_bi_sheng: They say a craftsman named Bi Sheng prints books with separate clay characters that can be rearranged at will.
news.n_chn_yellow_river_1048: The Yellow River has burst its dikes in Hebei and turned north in a new channel. Hundreds of thousands of refugees are on the roads.
news.n_chn_nong_zhigao: In the south the chieftain Nong Zhigao has rebelled and besieged Guangzhou.
news.n_chn_guest_star: The astronomers report that a “guest star” has flared up in the constellation of the Bull, so bright it can be seen even by day.
news.n_chn_su_brothers: The brothers Su Shi and Su Zhe from Sichuan have passed the examinations brilliantly. The examiner Ouyang Xiu is delighted.
news.n_chn_luoyang_bridge: Near Quanzhou the stone Luoyang Bridge across the river mouth is finished – more than half a mile long.
news.n_chn_zizhi_start: The historian Sima Guang has been commissioned to compile a universal history “as an aid to government”.
news.n_chn_manzikert: Arab merchants say the Seljuk Turks have defeated the army of the emperor of Rum and taken him prisoner.
news.n_chn_zheng_xia: They say the gatekeeper Zheng Xia presented the emperor with a painting of starving refugees, and Chancellor Wang Anshi lost his post.
news.n_chn_dai_viet: War with Dai Viet in the south: Song troops reached the Nhu Nguyet River but could not conquer the country.
news.n_chn_crow_terrace: The poet Su Shi has been arrested for verses said to slander the New Policies and exiled to Huangzhou.
news.n_chn_yongle_city: The Tanguts have taken the new fortress of Yongle; tens of thousands of soldiers and labourers have died.
news.n_chn_zizhi_done: Sima Guang has finished his history – nearly three hundred scrolls in nineteen years.
news.n_chn_shenzong_dies: Emperor Shenzong has died. Sima Guang has returned to court and is repealing Wang Anshi’s laws one after another.
news.n_chn_su_song_clock: In Kaifeng a clock tower has been built: water turns a wheel, and an armillary sphere rotates by itself.
news.n_chn_jerusalem: Merchants from the land of the Dashi say the Franks came from the west in arms and took the holy city of Jerusalem.
news.n_chn_huizong: Emperor Huizong has ascended the throne – a fine painter and calligrapher, they say.
news.n_chn_su_shi_dies: Su Shi has died on his way back from exile on Hainan island. His poems are sung across the land.
news.n_chn_blacklist: Chancellor Cai Jing has had the names of the “treacherous faction” – the reforms’ opponents – carved in stone. The late Sima Guang is on the list.
news.n_chn_huashigang: All over the south strange rocks and trees are being sought for the imperial garden. For a single boulder, they say, bridges and houses are torn down.
news.n_chn_jin_founded: In the far north-east the Jurchen chief Aguda has proclaimed himself emperor of a state called Jin.
news.n_chn_sea_alliance: The Song has made an alliance with the Jurchens against the Khitans. The envoys travelled by sea.
news.n_chn_yanjing: The Jurchens have taken Yanjing, the Khitans’ southern capital. The Song troops disgraced themselves there.
news.n_chn_liao_falls: The Khitans are destroyed and their last emperor captured. The Jurchens have turned their armies south.
news.n_chn_jingkang: Terrible news: Kaifeng has fallen, and both emperors are prisoners of the Jurchens. Prince Zhao Gou has been proclaimed emperor in the south.
news.n_chn_huangtiandang: General Han Shizhong trapped the Jurchen fleet on the Yangzi at Huangtiandang; his wife Liang Hongyu beat the war drum.
news.n_chn_huizong_dies: They say the former emperor Huizong has died in captivity far in the north.
news.n_chn_linan: The court has settled in Hangzhou, now called Lin’an.
news.n_chn_yancheng: General Yue Fei has routed the Jurchen cavalry at Yancheng. They say he is just two days from Kaifeng.
news.n_chn_shaoxing_peace: Peace with the Jin is concluded; the border will run along the Huai River. General Yue Fei has been executed.
news.n_chn_hailing: The Jin emperor has been murdered; his cousin Hailing has seized the throne.
news.n_chn_zhongdu: The Jin emperor has moved his capital to Yanjing and named it Zhongdu – the “Central Capital”.
news.n_chn_qin_hui_dies: The all-powerful chancellor Qin Hui has died. Few mourn him.
news.n_chn_caishi: At Caishi on the Yangzi the Song fleet, with paddle-wheel ships and thunderclap bombs, beat back the Jin crossing. Hailing was killed by his own generals.
news.n_chn_synagogue: They say that in Kaifeng the Jews, who came long ago from Persia, have built their own temple.
news.n_chn_longxing: A new peace has been signed with the Jin: the tribute is a little smaller, and the Song emperor no longer calls himself a vassal.
news.n_chn_lu_you: The poet Lu You has gone to serve in Sichuan and keeps a travel diary – sailing up the Yangzi through the gorges, they say.
news.n_chn_saladin: Arab merchants say the general Salah ad-Din has taken power in Egypt.
news.n_chn_goose_lake: At Goose Lake Temple the philosophers Zhu Xi and Lu Jiuyuan debated: should one learn from books, or from one’s own heart?
news.n_chn_zhu_xi_granaries: During the famine Zhu Xi set up community granaries that lend grain in spring to be repaid in autumn.
news.n_chn_jerusalem_1187: Merchants from the land of the Dashi say Salah ad-Din has retaken Jerusalem from the Franks.
news.n_chn_four_books: Zhu Xi has published his commentaries on the Four Books. Teachers are already making pupils learn them by heart.
news.n_chn_yellow_river_1194: The Yellow River has burst its dikes again and turned south into the Huai’s channel. Vast lands are flooded.
news.n_chn_false_learning: Zhu Xi’s teaching has been declared “false learning”; his followers are being driven from office.
news.n_chn_zhu_xi_dies: The philosopher Zhu Xi has died, still in disgrace. Thousands of students came to say farewell.
news.n_chn_hangzhou_fire: A great fire in Lin’an: tens of thousands of houses have burned.
news.n_chn_genghis: Merchants from the steppe say the chieftain Temüjin has united the Mongol tribes and taken the name Genghis Khan.
news.n_chn_mongols_jin: The Mongols have attacked the Jin and routed their armies at Yehuling pass.
news.n_chn_jin_to_kaifeng: The Jin court has fled the Mongols, moving from Zhongdu to Kaifeng.
news.n_chn_zhongdu_falls: The Mongols have taken and burned Zhongdu. They say the city burned for more than a month.
news.n_chn_khwarazm: Genghis Khan has led his armies west against the Khwarazm-shah. The caravan merchants are terrified.
news.n_chn_changchun: The Daoist master Qiu Changchun has set out across the deserts to Genghis Khan – to tell him about long life.
news.n_chn_genghis_dies: Genghis Khan is dead, but the Tangut kingdom of Xia has been destroyed.
news.n_chn_thunder_bombs: They say Kaifeng’s defenders hurl iron “thunder-crash bombs” at the Mongols, heard a hundred li away.
news.n_chn_jin_falls: The Jin empire has fallen. Song troops tried to retake Kaifeng and Luoyang, but the Mongols drove them out.
news.n_chn_war_begins: The Mongols have begun war on the Song: their armies are moving into Sichuan and towards the Huai.
news.n_chn_chengdu_falls: News has come: the Mongols have taken and ravaged Chengdu.
news.n_chn_lixue: The emperor has declared Zhu Xi’s teaching the only orthodoxy. His commentaries are now the basis of the examinations.
news.n_chn_diaoyu: In Sichuan the fortress of Diaoyu has been built on a mountain near Hechuan to hold back the Mongols.
news.n_chn_song_ci: The judge Song Ci has published a book on examining the bodies of the dead and telling murder from accident.
news.n_chn_baghdad: Merchants from the west say the Mongols have taken Baghdad and killed the caliph.
news.n_chn_mongke: The Great Khan Möngke has died beneath the walls of Diaoyu fortress in Sichuan. The Mongol armies are withdrawing.
news.n_chn_khubilai: Khubilai has been proclaimed Great Khan and has issued his own paper money.
news.n_chn_dadu_start: Khubilai has begun building a new capital beside the ruins of Zhongdu.
news.n_chn_xiangyang_siege: The Mongols have laid siege to Xiangyang on the Han River.
news.n_chn_yuan: Khubilai has given his dynasty a Chinese name – Yuan, the “Origin”.
news.n_chn_xiangyang_falls: After five years of siege Xiangyang has fallen: Mongol trebuchets breached the walls.
news.n_chn_japan_1274: Khubilai’s fleet sailed against Japan but turned back: a storm and Japanese warriors.
news.n_chn_linan_falls: The Song capital has surrendered to the Mongols without a fight; the child emperor has been taken north.
news.n_chn_yamen: The last Song fleet has been destroyed at Yamen. Minister Lu Xiufu leapt into the sea with the little emperor in his arms.
news.n_chn_kamikaze: Khubilai’s second fleet has perished off Japan in a terrible typhoon.
news.n_chn_wen_tianxiang: The Song minister Wen Tianxiang has been executed in Dadu for refusing to serve the Mongols. Before he died he bowed to the south.
news.n_chn_bach_dang: Dai Viet has destroyed a Mongol fleet on the Bach Dang River: the ships were impaled on stakes driven into the riverbed.
news.n_chn_quake_1290: A great earthquake near Dadu; they say tens of thousands have died.
news.n_chn_polo_leaves: They say a fleet has sailed from Quanzhou carrying a Mongol princess to wed the khan of Persia – and with it that Frankish merchant.
news.n_chn_tonghui: The Tonghui canal is finished: barges of southern rice now reach the very walls of Dadu.
news.n_chn_khubilai_dies: Khubilai has died. A monk from the far west, they say, has come to Dadu to preach the faith of Jesus.
news.n_chn_huang_daopo: They say the weaver Huang Daopo has returned from Hainan and taught her neighbours new looms for cotton.
news.n_chn_montecorvino: The Frankish friar John, who is building churches of his faith in Dadu, has been made an archbishop by his pope.
news.n_chn_exams_1315: The Mongols are holding examinations again – for the first time in decades, but with quotas for each people.
news.n_chn_two_capitals: The War of the Two Capitals: Dadu and Shangdu have each enthroned a different emperor.
news.n_chn_epidemic_1331: Pestilence in Hebei; they say most of the people have died.
news.n_chn_toghon: Thirteen-year-old Toghon Temür has been placed on the throne.
news.n_chn_five_surnames: A terrible rumour is going round: Chancellor Bayan proposed killing every Han Chinese surnamed Zhang, Wang, Liu, Li or Zhao.
news.n_chn_flood_1344: The Yellow River has burst its dikes in Shandong; fields are drowned and salt works ruined.
news.n_chn_black_death: Merchants from the west tell of a great pestilence in the lands of the Franks and Arabs: whole cities are dying.
news.n_chn_red_turbans: The Red Turbans, followers of the White Lotus, have risen along the Huai.
news.n_chn_han_liner: The rebels have proclaimed Han Lin’er the “Little Prince of Light” of a new Song dynasty.
news.n_chn_nanjing: The rebel leader Zhu Yuanzhang has taken Nanjing.
news.n_chn_poyang: On Lake Poyang Zhu Yuanzhang has destroyed Chen Youliang’s fleet; Chen himself was killed by an arrow.
news.n_chn_suzhou: Zhu Yuanzhang has taken Suzhou after a long siege; Zhang Shicheng hanged himself in captivity.
news.n_chn_ming: Zhu Yuanzhang has proclaimed the Ming dynasty, and his armies have taken Dadu. The Mongol court has fled to the steppe.
news.n_chn_timur: Merchants from the west tell of a lame warrior, Timur, who has seized Samarkand.
news.n_chn_mongolia_1372: The Ming campaign into Mongolia has ended in defeat: the Mongol general Köke Temür routed Xu Da’s army.
news.n_chn_baochao: The Ming treasury has issued its own paper money – large sheets inscribed “Precious Note of the Great Ming”.
news.n_chn_hu_weiyong: Chancellor Hu Weiyong has been executed for conspiracy. The emperor has abolished the office of chancellor.
news.n_chn_yellow_registers: Every household and field in the land is being recorded in the “yellow registers”.
news.n_chn_jinyiwei: The emperor has created the Embroidered Uniform Guard – a secret police that arrests without trial.
news.n_chn_buir: General Lan Yu has defeated the Mongols at Lake Buir and captured tens of thousands.
news.n_chn_lan_yu: General Lan Yu has been executed for conspiracy; thousands, they say, died with him.
news.n_chn_north_south_exam: Only southerners passed the examinations. The furious emperor executed the examiner and rewrote the list himself.
news.n_chn_hongwu_dies: The Hongwu emperor has died; his young grandson Jianwen has taken the throne.
news.n_chn_jingnan_war: In Beiping the Prince of Yan, the emperor’s uncle, has rebelled. War has begun.
news.n_chn_yongle: The Prince of Yan has taken Nanjing and become the Yongle emperor. The palace burned, and the scholar Fang Xiaoru was executed for refusing to write the edict.
news.n_chn_beijing_named: Beiping has been renamed Beijing – the “Northern Capital”.
news.n_chn_zheng_he: The eunuch Zheng He’s vast fleet has sailed from Longjiang for the Western Ocean.
news.n_chn_yongle_dadian: The Yongle Encyclopedia is complete – more than eleven thousand volumes.
news.n_chn_mongol_campaign: The Yongle emperor has personally led an army into the Mongol steppe.
news.n_chn_grand_canal: The Grand Canal is being dredged and repaired: soon southern grain will travel north by water again.
news.n_chn_giraffe: A qilin has been brought from overseas – a tall beast with a spotted hide. Courtiers say it is a sign of the sovereign’s virtue.
news.n_chn_tang_saier: In Shandong Tang Sai’er, the “Buddha Mother”, a White Lotus follower, has risen in revolt.
news.n_chn_capital_1421: The capital has moved to Beijing. In spring lightning set fire to three new palace halls.
news.n_chn_yongle_dies: The Yongle emperor has died on campaign in the steppe.
news.n_chn_vietnam_1427: Ming troops have left Dai Viet: the country could not be held.
news.n_chn_seventh_voyage: Zheng He has set out on his seventh voyage.
news.n_chn_voyages_end: The fleet has returned without Zheng He: they say he died on the voyage. There will be no more such expeditions.
news.n_chn_zhengtong: The eight-year-old Zhengtong emperor has ascended the throne. His tutor is the eunuch Wang Zhen.
news.n_chn_deng_maoqi: In Fujian the tenant farmers have risen under Deng Maoqi: they refuse to bring their landlords “gifts” on top of the rent.
news.n_chn_tumu: The emperor has been defeated by the Oirats at Tumu and taken prisoner.
news.n_chn_emperor_returns: The Oirats have released the captive emperor. But his brother now sits on the throne, and the former sovereign is locked away in the Southern Palace.
news.n_chn_constantinople: Merchants from the west say the Turks have taken the great city of Rum – Constantinople.
news.n_chn_duomen: A coup: the former emperor is back on the throne, and Yu Qian, the saviour of Beijing, has been executed.
news.n_chn_cao_qin: General Cao Qin has mutinied in Beijing and perished.
news.n_chn_jingxiang: In the Jing-Xiang mountains runaway peasants whom the authorities won’t allow to settle there have risen in revolt.
news.n_chn_ordos_wall: Minister Yu Zijun has built a long wall along the Ordos.
news.n_chn_western_depot: The eunuch Wang Zhi heads a new secret service – the Western Depot. Officials fear him more than the emperor.
news.n_chn_hongzhi: The Hongzhi emperor has ascended the throne; they say he has only one wife and not a single concubine.
news.n_chn_liu_daxia: Minister Liu Daxia has closed the Yellow River breaches so the river won’t cut the Grand Canal.
news.n_chn_gama: Merchants from the Southern Seas say bearded foreigners from the west have reached Calicut by sailing round Africa.
news.n_chn_zhengde: The young Zhengde emperor has taken the throne. They say he prefers games and hunting to memorials.
news.n_chn_liu_jin: The all-powerful eunuch Liu Jin has been executed; mountains of gold and silver were found in his house.
news.n_chn_malacca: The Folangji – westerners – have seized Malacca, a Ming tributary.
news.n_chn_tunmen: Folangji ships have appeared near Guangzhou. They fire their cannon in salute and frighten everyone.
news.n_chn_prince_ning: The rebellion of the Prince of Ning has been crushed in just over forty days by the scholar-official Wang Shouren.
news.n_chn_great_rites: The new Jiajing emperor is arguing with his ministers about whom to honour as his father. The “Great Rites” dispute is ending in beatings for officials.
news.n_chn_ningbo: In Ningbo two rival Japanese embassies fought and burned half the town. The court is thinking of closing sea trade altogether.
news.n_chn_wang_yangming: The philosopher Wang Yangming has died. His teaching: “Knowledge and action are one.”
news.n_chn_renyin: They say palace maids tried to strangle the emperor in his sleep.
news.n_chn_shuangyu: Governor Zhu Wan has destroyed the island of Shuangyu – a smugglers’ nest.
news.n_chn_altan: Altan Khan has broken through to Beijing itself and is plundering the suburbs.
news.n_chn_outer_wall: A new outer wall is being built around the southern part of Beijing.
news.n_chn_shaanxi_quake: A terrible earthquake in Shaanxi: hundreds of thousands are said to have died as the cave dwellings collapsed in the night.
news.n_chn_macau: With the authorities’ permission the Folangji have settled at Macau, at the mouth of the Pearl River.
news.n_chn_wang_zhi: Wang Zhi, the king of the smugglers, has been executed. He was lured in with a promise of pardon.
news.n_chn_hai_rui: The official Hai Rui has submitted a memorial telling the emperor he rules badly – and bought himself a coffin in advance.
news.n_chn_yuegang: The sea ban has been eased: private merchants may now sail to the Southern Seas from the port of Yuegang.
news.n_chn_manila: The Spaniards have founded Manila. Fujianese junks carry silk to them and come back with silver.
news.n_chn_wanli: Nine-year-old Wanli has taken the throne; Grand Secretary Zhang Juzheng runs the country.
news.n_chn_bencao: The physician Li Shizhen has finished his Compendium of Materia Medica – nearly two thousand remedies and thirty years’ work.
news.n_chn_zhang_dies: Grand Secretary Zhang Juzheng has died. His enemies are already pressing for the confiscation of all he had.
news.n_chn_hai_rui_dies: The honest official Hai Rui has died. Only a few strings of cash for his funeral were found in his house.
news.n_chn_imjin: The Japanese have invaded Korea. The emperor is sending troops to help the Korean king.
news.n_chn_imjin_2: The Japanese have landed in Korea again; Ming troops are at war once more.
news.n_chn_hideyoshi: The Japanese ruler Hideyoshi has died, and his troops have left Korea.
news.n_chn_ricci: The Western scholar Li Madou has been admitted to Beijing. He presented the emperor with a clock that strikes by itself.
news.n_chn_manila_1603: Terrible news from Manila: the Spaniards have massacred thousands of Chinese merchants and craftsmen.
news.n_chn_euclid: The scholar Xu Guangqi and Li Madou have translated the first books of the Elements by the Western sage Euclid.
news.n_chn_ricci_dies: Li Madou has died in Beijing. The emperor granted land for his grave.
news.n_chn_nurhaci: In the north-east the Jurchen chief Nurhaci has proclaimed himself khan of the Later Jin.
news.n_chn_sarhu: At Sarhu Nurhaci’s forces have crushed a large Ming army.
news.n_chn_wei_zhongxian: The eunuch Wei Zhongxian rules in the emperor’s name; honest officials of the Donglin Academy are being thrown into prison. The Dutch have settled on Taiwan.
news.n_chn_ningyuan: At Ningyuan Western cannon beat off Nurhaci’s assault. They say the khan himself is wounded.
news.n_chn_chongzhen: The new Chongzhen emperor has brought down Wei Zhongxian, who hanged himself.
news.n_chn_shaanxi_revolt: Drought in Shaanxi, and the soldiers are unpaid. Bands of starving rebels roam the province.
news.n_chn_yuan_chonghuan: General Yuan Chonghuan, who defended the border against the Manchus, has been executed on a false charge.
news.n_chn_fengyang: Rebels have burned Fengyang, the dynasty founder’s home town, and ravaged his ancestors’ tombs.
news.n_chn_qing: The Manchu ruler Hong Taiji has named his state Qing and proclaimed himself emperor.
news.n_chn_tiangong: The scholar Song Yingxing has published The Exploitation of the Works of Nature – on every craft, from smelting iron to making paper.
news.n_chn_luoyang: Li Zicheng has taken Luoyang; the hungry flock to him by the thousand.
news.n_chn_kaifeng_flood: During the siege of Kaifeng the Yellow River dikes were breached. The city is flooded, and almost all its people have died.
news.n_chn_ming_falls: Li Zicheng has taken Beijing; the Chongzhen emperor has taken his own life.
news.n_chn_qing_beijing: The Manchus have come through the Shanhai Pass and entered Beijing. They say all men are to shave their foreheads and wear a queue.
